name: NTN Corporation
summary: NTN Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells bearings, products, and CVJ axle products in Japan, the United States, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers rolling bearings, including radial and thrust ball, radial and thrust roller, special purpose, and linear motion bearings; plummer blocks; bearing units; sliding bearings; constant velocity joints; auto tensioners; clutches; electric motors and actuators; sensor related products; parts feeders; condition monitoring systems; sintered machine parts; and power generators.
